Bind both new generic modules in CMake and the runner in identical order;regress complete ordered adapter identities for both plugin and non-plugin profiles;retain prior loader inputs and witness.
Existing Cargo dependency/lock tuples remain unchanged;one test-only example compiles28exact actual source-module unit cases and exercises4real-upstream plugins plus4upstream-built token templates.

Public service fixture requires6zero-value native transactions,exact ALP/SLP plugin maps/groups/history/UTXOs,joined process reopen,new separate upstream reconstruction,and drift/version-index refusals while native mining continues.
New fixture has one CI repetition and12synthetic oracle tests;all inherited scenarios,assertions,repetitions,execution budgets,standalone profiles and seven CI jobs are preserved.
